title: Barcelona tapas and wine tour
text: This was a wonderful tour! We were only in Barcelona for a short stay, taking a cruise the next day. This was a great intro to the food, wine, and history of Barcelona. Our tour guide was great! Lots was walking and it was extremely hot but the restaurant staff was courteous and the food/wine was overall pretty good. Would recommend..especially as an evening tour.

title: Vibes
text: Montse was an amazing guide! She was so knowledgeable about everything and you can tell she really loved what she was teaching us! All of the food was out of this world, and worked with many food allergies. I can not recommend this enough!
author: ajp385

title: Discovering local secret spots
text: It was a pleasure to be guided by Montse who is a local Catalan with a rich knowledge and passion about the area. The tour involved a good balance of food, drinks, walking and knowledge sharing. Montse showed us some secret spots only a local would know about and was personable, patient and treated us like a friend. This tour will take you to places you would never know about unless you're a passionate local. You will also leave satisfied from the variety of tapas and drinks provided.
author: Geraldine_P

title: Tapas and Architectural History
text:
We had a fantastic tapas walking tour in the Eixample district of Barcelona and it ended up being one of the highlights of our visit.

The tour started with a wonderful meal featuring a selection of traditional Catalan tapas—many of which we had never tried before. It was a great introduction to the local cuisine and a relaxed way to begin the evening.
